items.source: The default autowired annotation types are the Spring-provided @Autowired and @Value annotations as well as the common @Inject annotation, if available.

items.source: In addition to regular injection points as discussed above, this post-processor also handles Spring's @Lookup annotation which identifies lookup methods to be replaced by the container at runtime. This is essentially a type-safe version of getBean(Class, args) and getBean(String, args). See @Lookup's javadoc for details.
items.translation: 除了上述讨论的常规注入点外，此后置处理器还处理 Spring 的@Lookup注解，该注解标识需要在运行时由容器替换的查找方法。这本质上是getBean(Class, args)和getBean(String, args)的类型安全版本。有关详细信息，请参阅@Lookup 的 javadoc。

items.source: Only one constructor of any given bean class may declare this annotation with the 'required' attribute set to true, indicating the constructor to autowire when used as a Spring bean. Furthermore, if the 'required' attribute is set to true, only a single constructor may be annotated with @Autowired. If multiple non-required constructors declare the annotation, they will be considered as candidates for autowiring. The constructor with the greatest number of dependencies that can be satisfied by matching beans in the Spring container will be chosen. If none of the candidates can be satisfied, then a primary/default constructor (if present) will be used. If a class only declares a single constructor to begin with, it will always be used, even if not annotated. An annotated constructor does not have to be public.
items.translation: 任何给定的 Bean 类中，最多只能有一个构造函数声明此注解并将 `required` 属性设置为 `true`，以指示在作为 Spring Bean 使用时进行自动装配的该构造函数。此外，如果 `required` 属性设置为 `true`，则只能有一个构造函数被标注为 `@Autowired`。如果有多个非必需构造函数声明了该注解，它们将被视为自动装配的候选项。将选择依赖项数量最多且能够通过匹配 Spring 容器中的 Bean 来满足的构造函数。如果没有任何候选项可以满足，则将使用主/默认构造函数（如果存在）。如果一个类最初只声明了一个构造函数，即使未标注，也将始终使用该构造函数。标注的构造函数不必是公开的。

items.source: Also supports the common @Inject annotation, if available, as a direct alternative to Spring's own @Autowired.
items.translation: 同时也支持常见的 `@Inject` 注解（如果可用），可作为 Spring 自身 `@Autowired` 的直接替代方案。

items.source: A default AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor will be registered by the "context:annotation-config" and "context:component-scan" XML tags. Remove or turn off the default annotation configuration there if you intend to specify a custom AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor bean definition.
items.translation: 默认情况下，`<context:annotation-config>` 和 `<context:component-scan>` XML 标签将注册一个 `AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor`。如果您打算指定自定义的 `AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` Bean 定义，请移除或禁用这些标签中的默认注解配置。

items.source: NOTE: Annotation injection will be performed before XML injection; thus the latter configuration will override the former for properties wired through both approaches.
items.translation: 注意： 注解注入将在 XML 注入之前执行；因此，对于通过这两种方式连接的属性，后者的配置将覆盖前者。

items.source: For example if using 'required=true' (the default), this value should be true; but if using 'optional=false', this value should be false.
items.translation: 例如，如果使用'required=true'（默认值），此值应为`true`；但如果使用'optional=false'，此值应为`false`。

items.source: Also supports the common @Inject annotation if available.
items.translation: 同时也支持常见的@Inject注解（如果可用）。

items.source:
Fields are injected right after construction of a bean, before any
config methods are invoked. Such a config field does not have to be public.
items.translation: 字段在 Bean 构建之后、任何配置方法调用之前注入。此类配置字段不必是公开的。

items.source:
Config methods may have an arbitrary name and any number of arguments; each of
those arguments will be autowired with a matching bean in the Spring container.
Bean property setter methods are effectively just a special case of such a
general config method. Config methods do not have to be public.
items.translation: 配置方法可以具有任意名称和任意数量的参数；这些参数中的每一个都将通过 Spring 容器与匹配的 Bean 进行自动注入。Bean 属性 setter 方法实际上只是此类通用配置方法的特例。配置方法不必是公开的。

items.source:
A 'required' dependency means that autowiring should fail when no beans
are found. Otherwise, the autowiring process will simply bypass the field
or method when no beans are found.
items.translation: “必需”依赖意味着当找不到任何 Bean 时，自动装配应该失败。否则，当找不到 Bean 时，自动装配过程将简单地跳过该字段或方法。

Processors are free to use any techniques they like to analyze the given
instance. Most typically use reflection to find fields or methods to use
in the contribution. Contributions typically generate source code or
resource files that can be used when the AOT optimized application runs.
items.translation: 处理器可以自由使用任何技术来分析给定的实例。大多数情况下，它们使用反射来查找用于贡献的字段或方法。贡献通常会生成源代码或资源文件，这些文件可在 AOT 优化后的应用程序运行时使用。
